t: Roblox Now Lets You Buy Real Products While Playing Games | Beebom
s: May 16, 2025 - Roblox has introduced Commerce APIs that allow the selling of real-world products through its in-game experiences. This is currently introduced in the U.S. for users aged 13 and above. Finally, the AMP feature allows sellers to pair their products with a redeemable code to give gifts in Roblox games. Roblox is taking a giant leap forward by merging the digital and physical worlds of shopping. What if I tell you that now, you can buy a cool hoodie while slaying dragons or get the perfect shade of lipstick while customizing your avatar, and that too without leaving your favorite Roblox experience?
